items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: No, no, no. Never worked with Pops Foster. In fact, I didn't know...I don't think I met him.

ctx.x: Pops Foster. Did you ever work with him, the bass player?
No, no, no. Never worked with Pops Foster. In fact, I didn't know...I don't think I met him.
He didn't come around Chicago much. Mostly St. Louis, New Orleans, St. Louis, and then New York.
